rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Priya — thank you, this is great timing. Here's something concrete and bounded: a short landscape scan (2-3 pages) of what's already well-served in independent AI-safety work right now — e.g. what Alignment Commons, Compute Commons, and similar efforts already cover for independent researchers — and where the real gaps are. I'm especially interested in candidate ideas for a small, measurable contribution a solo/part-time person could actually finish (think: a specific eval or benchmark gap), as opposed to things that are already crowded (general newsletters, reading groups, small-grants programs). If that's too broad or not your kind of task, happy to narrow it on a call instead. No rush beyond a couple of weeks. Thanks again for reaching out, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman with a concrete ask (landscape scan of what's already covered vs. the gaps, candidate project ideas).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I want to be careful that anything attributed to me by name publicly is something I can fully stand behind — I have an open question with my employer about outside public statements that I expect to resolve soon, and I'd rather sort that out before going on record. I won't be able to get you a quote by tomorrow's deadline. If the piece has legs beyond this deadline, I'd be glad to talk another time. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent holding replies to the reporter (Tessa Brandt) and Corvid Institute (open letter) — did NOT give a quote or sign anything.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for including Halcyon Threshold. I want to read the letter closely and make sure signing is consistent with an employment obligation I'm still clearing up before I put my name (and the org's) on anything published with press distribution — so I don't think I can confirm by Wednesday. If there's any flexibility on timing I'd appreciate knowing, but no hard feelings if the list closes before I'm able to confirm. Best, Morgan"
